name: looping
description: You keep repeating the same or circular steps without making progress.

name: cannot_do_request
description: The user asked for something you cannot do here: a missing capability, tool or permission, or it is only possible by cheating.

name: invalid_tool_or_credential
description: A tool, MCP server, plugin, API key or token you need is broken, invalid, expired or rejected.

name: missing_context
description: Information or access you need is missing and you cannot get it yourself. Not for normal clarifying questions.

name: repeated_tool_failure
description: A command or tool failed on several distinct attempts and is blocking you. A single error is not enough.

name: task_failure
description: You genuinely tried and could not complete the task. Not for refusals or policy blocks.
